mapper.select: select category_cd as id, category_name as name FROM Category order by category_name
select partner_id as id, partner_name as name FROM Partner order by partner_name
select section_id as id, section_name as name FROM Section order by section_name
SELECT section_id AS id, section_name AS name FROM Section WHERE warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} ORDER BY section_name
SELECT DISTINCT w.warehouse_id AS id, w.warehouse_name AS name FROM Warehouse w JOIN ProductStock ps ON w.warehouse_id = ps.warehouse_id WHERE ps.quantity > 0 ORDER BY w.warehouse_name
